name: Varify MCP
description: Varify MCP connects Claude to your Varify.io A/B testing account, letting you manage experiments directly through conversation. Create new experiments and variations, or edit, duplicate, pause, and archive existing ones. Adjust traffic allocation between variants and define page and audience targeting by URL, device, browser, or UTM parameters. Turn tracking on or off per experiment. If GA4 is connected, view results directly, including daily reports and revenue analyses based on GA4 data. Agencies get an overview of all managed client accounts in one place. The MCP uses the same public API available for custom integrations.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Varify MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Varify MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.varify.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Varify MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Varify MCP provides these MCP tools: create_experiment, duplicate_experiment, get_experiment, get_experiment_daily_report, get_experiment_raw_revenue_report, get_experiment_report, list_accounts, list_experiments, toggle_experiment_tracking, update_experiment, update_experiment_status, and update_experiment_traffic_allocation.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Varify MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Varify MCP in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Varify MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Varify MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Varify MCP is developed by Varify.io. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
